latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — turn still photos into animated video clips with AI.

- Upload JPG, PNG, WEBP, or HEIC images (up to 200MB) and convert them into 1080p MP4 videos with transitions, ready for social media.
- Simple chat prompts initiate tasks like animation, adding transitions, customizing aspect ratio, overlays, or background music.
- No manual animation or editing; fast cloud rendering in about 30–90 seconds.
- Free anonymous access with 100 credits (valid 7 days) by generating a token during setup.
- Built-in workflows for uploading, editing, previewing, and exporting videos.
- Integrated error handling and guides for supported formats, credits, and troubleshooting.
